description: Tasks template for modernization plan. Generate this file alongside plan.md to track individual migration tasks.

tasks.description: Upgrade the application runtime to the latest .NET LTS so the modernization can use current Azure platform capabilities.
tasks.reason: Current target .NET Framework 4.7.2 is out of mainstream support and blocks modern cloud-native modernization.
tasks.requirements: Upgrade the application from .NET Framework 4.7.2 to .NET 10 and convert to an SDK-style project while preserving existing functional behavior.

tasks.description: Replace Windows authentication with Microsoft Entra ID for Azure-compatible application authentication. Addresses issues: Windows authentication detected.
tasks.reason: Windows authentication is not supported for the assessed Azure targets and is a mandatory modernization blocker.
tasks.requirements: Migrate application authentication and authorization from Windows authentication to Microsoft Entra ID with app-role/group-based access for reporting operators.

tasks.description: Move in-process ASP.NET session state to Azure Cache for Redis to support scale-out hosting. Addresses issues: Session state stored in-proc or in local process is detected.
tasks.reason: In-proc session state is a cloud scale risk and prevents reliable horizontal scaling.
tasks.requirements: Externalize session state from in-process storage to Azure Cache for Redis and preserve existing session-driven user workflows.

tasks.description: Remove embedded credential-style connection settings and use managed identity with secure configuration sources. Addresses issues: Connection strings without configuration builders detected.
tasks.reason: Hard-coded credential-style configuration is a security risk and does not meet cloud security best practices.
tasks.requirements: Replace local credential-style configuration with managed identity and Azure Key Vault-backed secrets/configuration while preserving required reporting configuration values.

tasks.description: Generate Bicep Infrastructure as Code for the target Azure resources required by the modernization solutions.
tasks.reason: The plan requires IaC preparation for each modernization solution while deferring actual resource provisioning.
tasks.requirements: Generate Bicep templates for Azure Container Apps hosting, managed identity, Azure Cache for Redis, Azure Key Vault, and observability resources; do not provision resources.

tasks.description: Scan and remediate known dependency CVEs before deployment.
tasks.reason: Security remediation is required in every modernization plan to reduce known vulnerability risk.
tasks.requirements: Scan project dependencies for CVEs, upgrade vulnerable packages to minimum patched versions, document major-version upgrade risks if required, and verify build/test status after remediation.

tasks.description: Deploy the modernized application to Azure Container Apps using generated IaC artifacts and deployment automation.
tasks.reason: A deployment task is required to complete migration readiness after code and infrastructure artifacts are prepared.
tasks.requirements: Package and deploy the modernized application to Azure Container Apps using generated Bicep IaC, managed identity authentication, and secure runtime configuration.
